description: VillagerDupe Fabric mod; 1.21.6+ is the project target, current release jar is for 26.2 only

mods.name: VillagerDupe
mods.description: Standalone client command for villager offhand interactions.

releases.notes:
Project target: Minecraft 1.21.6 and newer.

This v1.0.0 jar is built for Minecraft 26.2 only. Fabric will reject it on 1.21.6. A jar for 1.21.6 has not been released yet.

Standalone client-side Fabric mod. Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Fabric API, and Java 25.

Commands: /villagerdupe and /villagerdupe auto [saddle|horse_armor|carpet].
